budgets.A1_caveat: Token-budget matching is vacuous under a single-field contract: the model terminates after the answer regardless of allowance. A1 is run to demonstrate this, not to claim compute matching.
budgets.accounting: R0 shared across A0/A2/A3; S1 diagnostic adds one call outside the five-call A3; logical per-arm and unique actual totals both reported

changed_from_MRS1: R2/R3 lose their unsatisfiable boolean-field sentences
smoke gate widened to all nine consumed roles
constant-answer baseline reported alongside every arm
constant_baseline: reported for every arm, family and difficulty stratum
future: same frozen protocol with a distinct registered checkpoint; hash-bound P0/P1/P2 receipts required for cells C and D
oracle: analysis only after generation; never a selector input
parser: exactly one in-vocabulary answer token; EOS required; no repair of any kind
selector_projection_caveat: Under a single-field contract S1 and S2 receive the same shape of information and differ only in candidate source. This is weaker than MRS-1 intended and is registered.

selectors.S0: valid-answer majority; first valid role breaks ties
selectors.S1: answer-only model selector over repeated-direct candidates
selectors.S2: model selector over the diverse roles; primary A3 output
